questions.q: What is the target for the first meaningful response on a case?
questions.e: Acknowledgement within 1 working hour, first meaningful response within 4 working hours. Both are measured from the case timestamps, which are stamped automatically.

questions.q: How quickly should a new inbound customer item be acknowledged?
o: Within 1 working hour, or 15 minutes if it is urgent
By the end of the day
questions.e: Acknowledge within 1 working hour, 15 minutes for an urgent operational problem. The first meaningful response follows within 4 working hours.

questions.q: In the Tuesday pipeline sweep, which side wins on stage and close date?
questions.e: The CRM wins on stage and close date; the sheet wins on amount, probability and next step. That way the sweep never silently moves a deal's stage or invents a close date.

questions.q: A deal will genuinely not close until next year. What is the right thing to do?
o: Leave the next-step date in the past so it keeps appearing
Close it as lost and recreate it later
Set the next-step date months out to its real cadence
questions.e: A long-cycle deal is not overdue, it is mis-dated. Push the date out to the real touch cadence - the pulse gives you plus-one-month and plus-three-month buttons for exactly this.
